A User resource gives ACLs (or profiles) to a user who logs in through a PAM console.

## Examples

**A PAM user**

```text
User {
  Name = alice
  Profile = operator
}
```

## Directives

| Directive | Type | Default | | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Name](#d-name) | name |  | required | Name of the user, as PAM authenticated it through a PAM console. |
| [Description](#d-description) | string |  |  | Free text describing the user. |
| [Job ACL](#d-jobacl) | ACL list |  |  | Which jobs this user may use. |
| [Client ACL](#d-clientacl) | ACL list |  |  | Which clients this user may use. |
| [Storage ACL](#d-storageacl) | ACL list |  |  | Which storages this user may use. |
| [Schedule ACL](#d-scheduleacl) | ACL list |  |  | Which schedules this user may use. |
| [Pool ACL](#d-poolacl) | ACL list |  |  | Which pools this user may use. |
| [Command ACL](#d-commandacl) | ACL list |  |  | Which console commands this user may use. |
| [File Set ACL](#d-filesetacl) | ACL list |  |  | Which FileSets this user may use. |
| [Catalog ACL](#d-catalogacl) | ACL list |  |  | Which catalogs this user may use. |
| [Where ACL](#d-whereacl) | ACL list |  |  | Which restore target paths (the where= of a restore) this user may use. |

### Name {#d-name}

Key: `name` · Type: name · Required

Name of the user, as PAM authenticated it through a PAM console.

```text
User {
  Name = "alice"
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add user name=alice
```

### Description {#d-description}

Key: `description` · Type: string

Free text describing the user.

```text
User {
  Name = alice
  Description = "Backup operator"
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add user name=alice description="Backup operator"
```

### Job ACL {#d-jobacl}

Key: `jobacl` · Type: ACL list

Which jobs this user may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, \*all\* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

```text
User {
  Name = alice
  Job ACL = backup-web, restore-files
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add user name=alice jobacl="backup-web, restore-files"
```

### Command ACL {#d-commandacl}

Key: `commandacl` · Type: ACL list

Which console commands this user may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, \*all\* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. A console that may use restore needs the dot commands the restore uses as well (for the GUI: .api, .help, .bvfs\_\* or .ovfs\_\*). On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

```text
User {
  Name = alice
  Command ACL = status, list, llist, restore, .api, .help
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add user name=alice commandacl="status, list, llist, restore, .api, .help"
```

### Catalog ACL {#d-catalogacl}

Key: `catalogacl` · Type: ACL list

Which catalogs this user may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, \*all\* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. A console that may use no catalog cannot list jobs or volumes. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

```text
User {
  Name = alice
  Catalog ACL = MyCatalog
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add user name=alice catalogacl=MyCatalog
```

### Where ACL {#d-whereacl}

Key: `whereacl` · Type: ACL list

Which restore target paths (the where= of a restore) this user may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, \*all\* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. An empty list forbids every where= other than the job's own; \*all\* allows any path. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

```text
User {
  Name = alice
  Where ACL = /tmp/bareos-restores
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add user name=alice whereacl=/tmp/bareos-restores
```

### Plugin Options ACL {#d-pluginoptionsacl}

Key: `pluginoptionsacl` · Type: ACL list

Which plugin option strings a job may be started with this user may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, \*all\* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

```text
User {
  Name = alice
  Plugin Options ACL = python:module_name=bareos-fd-local-fileset
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add user name=alice pluginoptionsacl=python:module_name=bareos-fd-local-fileset
```
